source.section: PDF page 60 Schedule CA (540) instructions, Line 5a and 5b (Military Retirement Exclusion, federal AGI limit 125,000 / 250,000, 20,000 cap); PDF page 6 and 55 What's New; Form 540 lines 13 to 19 and 31 to 33 (PDF pages 39-40); PDF page 13 Line 18 standard deduction chart and Line 31; PDF page 75 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Single, 58: uniformed-services retirement pay 40,000 and wages 95,000; federal AGI = 135,000, over the 125,000 limit ('must not exceed'), so no exclusion. Form 540 line 13 federal AGI = 135,000.00. Federal taxable income = 135,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 119,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Subtractions: Schedule CA (540) line 5, Military Retirement Exclusion: federal AGI 135,000.00 exceeds 125,000.00, so no exclusion (0.00); the military retirement pay 40,000.00 stays taxed. Schedule CA Part I line 27 column B = 0.00 = Form 540 line 14. Additions (line 16): 0.00. Line 15 = line 17 California AGI = 135,000.00 - 0.00 = 135,000.00. Line 18 California standard deduction (single, PDF page 13 chart) 5,706.00. Line 19 taxable income = 135,000.00 - 5,706.00 = 129,294.00. Tax on 129,294.00 by the projection's brackets: 11,079.00 x 1% = 110.79; 15,185.00 x 2% = 303.70; 15,188.00 x 4% = 607.52; 16,090.00 x 6% = 965.40; 15,182.00 x 8% = 1,214.56; 56,570.00 x 9.3% = 5,261.01; total 8,462.98. Line 31: Tax Rate Schedule X (PDF page 75), from its printed base, gives 8,462.98. Line 32 exemption credits: federal AGI 135,000.00 is not more than 252,203.00, so no AGI limitation; line 7 personal 1 x 153 = 153.00; line 9 senior 0 x 153 = 0.00; line 32 = 153.00. Line 33 = 8,462.98 - 153.00 = 8,309.98; no other credits (lines 34 to 47 nil), line 48 = 8,309.98. State income tax = 8,309.98.
